close_reason: Workspace-wide propagation: changed Inner::current_state in all 7 extension-server MemoryBackends (mail canonical first, then calendars/chat/contacts/metadata/sharing/tasks) from *...unwrap_or(&0) to .copied().unwrap_or(0). cargo test --workspace passes (143 test groups, 0 failures); per-crate clippy -D warnings clean on all 7 crates. Documented in std::option::Option::copied.
description:
memory.rs:142-147 — current_state:

  fn current_state(&self, type_name: &'static str, account_id: &str) -> u64 {
      *self
          .states
          .get(&(type_name, account_id.to_owned()))
          .unwrap_or(&0)                          // returns &u64
  }                                                // explicit * deref

The dereference + unwrap_or(&0) idiom requires the literal 0 to be coerced to &0, which only compiles because the compiler can put 0 in static storage. Rustaceans read 'unwrap_or(&0)' and pause to parse it. The standard idiom for 'extract a Copy value out of Option<&T>' is .copied():

  self.states.get(&(type_name, account_id.to_owned())).copied().unwrap_or(0)

Same shape, no & on the literal, no explicit deref needed at the call site. Documented in std::option::Option::copied.

This is workspace-wide — the canonical jmap-mail-server has the same shape at memory.rs:138.

Pure clippy-level idiom; behaviour is byte-identical.
title: Inner::current_state uses *…unwrap_or(&0) where .copied().unwrap_or(0) would be idiomatic
